t: Mapei Mapesil AC 120 is a professional-grade, solvent-free silicone sealant, designed for creating robust and flexible seals across various applications. This high-performance black silicone is perfect for trade professionals undertaking bathroom renovations, kitchen installations, and general sealing, effectively used around sanitaryware, wash basins, and shower trays. The formulation is completely waterproof and offers superior resistance to mould and mildew, ensuring a hygienic and enduring finish. It provides reliable sealing both indoors and outdoors, handling temperatures up to 180°C, making it a versatile and dependable choice for demanding wet environments.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
